description: Reduce the file size of the presentation 'product_showcase_heavy.odp' to under 5 MB. The presentation contains high-resolution images that make it too large for email attachments (~20MB). You must compress or minimize the images using LibreOffice's tools (e.g., 'Compress' in right-click menu or 'Minimize Presentation' tool) while preserving all 5 slides and all 5 visible images. Do not simply delete slides or images.
